name: MoveFolderNode
label: Move Folder
description: This activity moves an existing folder to a specified destination folder.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: SourceFolderPath
fields.label: Folder to Move
fields.description: Specifies the path of the folder that needs to be moved.

fields.name: DestinationFolderPath
fields.label: Destination Folder
fields.description: Specifies the path of the destination folder where the source folder will be moved.

fields.name: MovedFolderPath
fields.label: Moved Folder Path
fields.description: The path of the folder after it has been successfully moved.
